title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：spring　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spring 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the farmer ① greeted the spring that no child in the field would have noted, and he said the greeting was the whole of the autumn. The ② spring, meaning the season itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unnoted in the book; a spring, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ spring in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ spring at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A spring, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the farmer said the noting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the spring was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the season. The ⑥ spring, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; spring, he said, is either something you greet or the only word that means both a season and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ spring had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ spring of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of noting; spring, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ spring I remember is the season noted in the almanac, which closed in 1992 and is still noted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ spring, my mother said in 1994, is the only season that improves by being noted; every spring, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a season. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 春天；泉（指田垄里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 春天；泉（指那个春天本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：greet the spring 迎这一个春天
D. n. 春天；泉（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 春天之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的春天之事）
F. n. 春天；泉（指农事历里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 春天、生机（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 生机（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: greeted the spring that no child in the field would have noted
The spring, meaning the season itself and not the basket
the spring at the far fence
the spring was the whole of the matter
the spring had become a line in an almanac
The spring of the whole thing
A spring, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: greet the spring 意为“迎这一个春天”，1985 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记下的一个春天做了一遍。
spring 意为“春天；泉”，指那个春天本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记下。
spring 意为“春天；泉”，指田垄里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
spring 意为“春天；泉”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
spring 意为“春天、生机”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个生机就是那件事的全部。
spring 意为“生机”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个春天，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
spring 意为“春天；泉”，指农事历里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1990 年这一个成了农事历里的一行。
spring 意为“春天之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的春天之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记下。
spring 意为“春天；泉”，我记得的是农事历里记下过的那一个，1992 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一个。
spring 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，春天是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的春天。
